global.title: Space Force expands use of commercial satellites to track electronic interference
global.summary: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Space Force is expanding the use of commercial satellites to detect and locate GPS jamming and other electronic interference, turning what began as an experiment into a standing global operation.
global.why: Kept so the editor has a record of what was reported, not because a full desk sweep was done.
